_why: iter2 (riscv32i__2026-09-10): AREA 3 at 23.6 ns closes setup and hold at all nine corners; what is left is DRVs — 389 max-slew, 102 max-cap, 163 max-fanout, 53 antenna. On aes the same day, MAX_TRANSITION_CONSTRAINT 1.5 (the sky130_fd_sc_hd liberty's own max_transition, against OpenLane's 0.75 default) took max-slew from 570 to 0 without touching setup. First candidate applies that one change. The second also relaxes MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT to 16 — the register file's decode nets are the fanout offenders and gcd on gf180 closed its last violation the same way (the limit is OpenLane's default, not the PDK's). AREA 0 is dropped: it still misses setup by 1.66 ns at the measured period.
